items.note: The search field gets the dark ring with the pink halo. Under it hangs a raised dropdown with a 1px ink border, a hard offset shadow and radius.md, showing '2 results' and two rows, each with its section label on the right. The panel sits over the hero's sticker area and covers no text or controls.
Same results dropdown on the black ground. The panel is dark grey with a light border, the field ring is pink and the row text has full contrast. The stickers stay pink and yellow with ink outlines.

At phone width the search field spans the header under the Menu button and brand. The results panel overlaps only the top of the hero title, as a dropdown should, and both result rows are fully readable with their section labels.

The dropdown says '0 results', with a small pink star sticker and 'No results for "zzzz no match". Try a shorter or different word.' It tells people what happened and what to try, in the system's raised panel, and the clear (×) control sits in the field.
Dark version of the empty dropdown: grey raised panel, pink focus ring on the field, the pink star sticker and the two-line message. The text reads clearly against the panel.

Full-width empty dropdown under the mobile search field, with the star sticker and the wrapped 'No results… Try a shorter or different word' sentence. Nothing is clipped, and the hero below starts cleanly.

In the sidebar, the Guides group shows as an underlined label with a down chevron and its children hidden, while the other groups stay open with up chevrons. The current page is an ink pill. The installation page beside it has its teal band, breadcrumb and raised current-tab pill.

Dark sidebar with Guides collapsed (down chevron, children hidden) and the current page as a paper-filled pill. The teal band keeps ink text and a dark selected tab pill, and the callouts and code boxes keep their light borders.

After a click, the first code box's Copy button turns into a pink 'Copied' button with a check icon and the hard offset shadow, while the other Copy buttons stay ghost outlines. The confirmation sits right on the action, so it's clear the copy worked.
In dark mode the 'Copied' confirmation is a pink pill with an ink check next to the bash label. The other code boxes keep their outlined Copy buttons, and contrast is fine.

At phone width, the band collapses to the title and a pill strip. The npm code box shows the pink 'Copied' button with a check icon, and the long doctor output inside its box scrolls sideways instead of widening the page.
Keyboard focus is on the header search field, shown as a thick dark ring around the outlined input. It is clearly visible against the paper header, and the hero and card grid below are unchanged.
On dark, the focused search field carries the pink focus ring around its grey input. It is easy to spot in the black header and overlaps nothing.
Focus is on the brand link in the mobile header, drawn as a square ink ring around the brand mark and name, next to the Menu button. It is distinct from the outlined Menu button and the version pill.

The open menu is a raised drawer with an ink border and a hard shadow over a grey scrim. It has a ghost Close button, every group with up chevrons, and the current page as an ink pill. Every label is readable and the page behind is dimmed.

Four hero stickers: a pink coin with a yellow rim and a check, a tilted white tag with a terminal glyph, a white play coin with a pink rim, and a yellow star. Each has a heavy ink outline and flat fills from the tokens, matching the reference's coin-and-shape hero. The check coin is cut off at the hero's left edge, as the recipe asks.

A small teal speech-bubble sticker with a heavy ink outline and ink lines, used as the icon of the 'Was this page helpful?' prompt. Its teal fill matches the section's band, and it reads clearly at its small size.
The same feedback speech-bubble sticker, filled yellow for this section's band color, with the same ink outline. It is the same component in another section, not two figures sharing one drawing.
The frames show the hero coin's drift, which is tied to scroll (linear, runs once, no time loop), so the coin holds still from 39ms to 638ms without scrolling. Nothing else loops, as the spec asks.
